rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when someone is keen to do something, especially with strong anticipation.

example.english: We eagerly want to try the new restaurant.
example.traditional: 我哋急不及待咁想試下間新餐廳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gap1 bat1 kap6 doi6 gam3 soeng2 si3 haa5 gaan1 san1 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this when eagerly means listening, watching, or doing something with obvious interest.

example.traditional: 我好有興趣咁睇呢套紀錄片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 gam3 tai2 ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2

rows.note: Use this when people eagerly compete or volunteer to be the one who does something first.

example.english: The kids eagerly volunteered to answer the question.
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 zaang1 zyu6 daap3 man6 tai4
